title: Formula for positive power means
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, $p>0$, and $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb{R}$. Then $M_p(f)=\bigl(\mathbb{E}|f|^p\bigr)^{1/p}$, with expectation under the uniform measure.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the Boolean cube
replaced: For $p>0$ and $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$, the extended power mean agrees with the ordinary formula $M_p(f)=(\E|f|^p)^{1/p}$ under the uniform measure.
